instruction:
Two-Story GUI Office Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm in the task output folder.

Create 2 building stories, 10 spaces and 10 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: GUI-L1-South, GUI-L1-North, GUI-L1-West, GUI-L1-East, GUI-L1-Core, GUI-L2-South, GUI-L2-North, GUI-L2-West, GUI-L2-East and GUI-L2-Core. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area.

Model the enclosure with 68 total OS:Surface objects, split into 10 floor surfaces, 10 roof/ceiling surfaces and 48 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 10 Ground, 26 Outdoors and 32 Surface.

Add 16 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 184.32 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 10 ideal-loads air systems, 10 zone HVAC equipment lists and 10 dual-setpoint thermostats.

Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 30.00 m in X, 18.00 m in Y and 7.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 1080.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 614.40 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
